description: This file defines a mix-in class for pandas map operations within PySpark, including methods for mapInPandas and mapInArrow, and a test function for the module.

classes.name: PandasMapOpsMixin
classes.description: A mix-in class providing pandas map operation methods for DataFrame objects in PySpark.

methods.name: mapInPandas
methods.description: Performs a pandas map operation on a DataFrame using a user-defined function and schema.

methods.name: mapInArrow
methods.description: Performs an Arrow-based map operation on a DataFrame using a user-defined function and schema.

methods.name: _build_java_profile
methods.description: Constructs a Java ResourceProfile object based on a PySpark ResourceProfile.
